title: Benzinga's Top Upgrades, Downgrades November 2, 2018
text:

Allscripts Healthcare shares fell 14.5 percent to $10.29 in pre-market trading.

RA Medical closed at $10.55 on Thursday. Craig Hallum initiated coverage on RumbleON Inc (NASDAQ: RMBL ) with a Buy rating. The price target for RumbleON is set to $13.
